text:
When someone leaves a job, there are generally four things people do with an old 401(k), and each has trade-offs:

- Leave it in the old plan (keeps plan-level protections; limited menu)
- Roll to a new employer's plan (consolidation; depends on new plan's rules)
- Roll to an IRA (wider menu; may have different fees and fewer creditor protections)
- Cash out (taxes and possibly a 10% penalty)

I'm not suggesting any of these for you specifically; fees, your plan's investments, and your situation all matter, and a representative can go through them with you.
label: compliant
rationale: Lists all rollover options with balanced pros and cons and explicitly declines to recommend, which is the compliant counterpart of a Reg BI rollover recommendation.
